title: Exercise
subtitle: 「運動／鍛鍊／訓練／練習」，要先分清是廣義身體活動、一次 workout、長期 training、單一 movement，還是特定類型如 aerobic activity / st
description: 「運動／鍛鍊／訓練／練習」，要先分清是廣義身體活動、一次 workout、長期 training、單一 movement，還是特定類型如 aerobic activity / strength training。

words.example: Regular physical activity can improve cardiovascular health.
words.exampleZh: 定期體能活動可以改善心血管健康。

exercises.original: Regular exercise can improve cardiovascular health.
exercises.zh: 定期運動可以改善心血管健康。
exercises.upgrade: Regular physical activity can improve cardiovascular health.

options.explanation: public-health context + regular movement supports the broad term physical activity。
sport is only one possible form of physical activity。
game is narrower and usually rule-based。
stretching only covers one subtype。
workout session is a structured bout, while the sentence is broader。
practice focuses on skill development.

exercises.original: Older adults should include more exercise in daily life.
exercises.zh: 長者應在日常生活中加入更多身體活動。
exercises.upgrade: Older adults should include more physical activity in daily life.

options.explanation: daily-life health guidance usually uses physical activity as the broad category。
training implies a structured performance goal。
sport only excludes walking and other everyday movement。
game is too narrow。
movement only is too basic and does not necessarily imply health-related activity。
practice is skill-focused.

exercises.original: Walking to work is a useful form of exercise.
exercises.zh: 步行上班是一種有益的體能活動。
exercises.upgrade: Walking to work is a useful form of physical activity.

options.explanation: walking for active transport fits physical activity perfectly, even though it may not be a formal workout。
workout usually implies a dedicated exercise session。
drill is repetitive skill practice。
practice focuses on skill improvement。
sport has organised/rule-based connotations。
game is not the right category for commuting.

words.meaning: 鍛鍊；健身訓練；運動一節
words.example: I usually do a short workout before breakfast.

options.explanation: a dedicated session before breakfast is naturally a workout。

practice is skill-focused。
movement is too general。

game does not fit gym-style exercise。

falseSynonyms.zh: 運動項目不等於 exercise sport 通常有規則、技巧、競賽或休閒形式；exercise 可以完全沒有競賽。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Sport can involve exercise, but the concepts are not identical.

falseSynonyms.zh: 遊戲／比賽不等於 exercise game 是有規則的遊戲或競賽；它可能帶來運動量，但不是所有 exercise 都是 game。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A game may involve exercise, but exercise is broader.

falseSynonyms.zh: 伸展不等於所有 exercise stretch 是一種動作或伸展活動，只是 exercise 的一部分。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Stretching is one type of exercise.

falseSynonyms.zh: workout 和 exercise 很接近，但範圍較窄 workout 通常是一整節鍛鍊；exercise 也可指單一動作或廣義運動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A workout is usually a session of exercise.

falseSynonyms.zh: training 和 exercise 很接近，但通常更系統化 training 通常有持續目標、技能或表現提升；一般 exercise 未必。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Training is systematic; exercise can be casual.

falseSynonyms.zh: 練習不等於所有 exercise practice 偏技能熟練；exercise 可以純粹為健康、體能或復康。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Practice targets skill; exercise may target fitness.

falseSynonyms.zh: 動作不等於 exercise movement 是身體動作；exercise 通常是有目的的活動或訓練。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Movement is a component; exercise is purposeful activity.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 exercise 可作名詞或動詞；exercising 是動名詞／現在分詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Exercise can be a noun or verb; exercising is the -ing form.
